# CCSwitcherX

> CCSwitcherX is a free, open-source (MIT) unofficial Windows tool that switches the Claude Code login between your own saved accounts, such as a personal Max plan and a work Team plan, in one click. It has a small window, a VS Code status-bar extension and a command-line tool. Version 1.3.0 shows the account in use as a large panel and other accounts as compact rows sorted by room left, reads usage live for accounts not in use, and shows plan changes such as Pro to Max without signing in again. It needs only Python 3.9 or newer, with no pip packages. It is not affiliated with Anthropic.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/MHJoy99/CCSwitcherX#readme): what it does, install steps and usage.
- [FAQ](https://github.com/MHJoy99/CCSwitcherX/blob/main/docs/FAQ.md): questions and answers on switching, storage, usage, platforms and safety.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/MHJoy99/CCSwitcherX/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): how a switch works, the lock files, the backup and journal design.
- [Full description for LLMs](https://mhjoy99.github.io/CCSwitcherX/llms-full.txt): complete plain-text description, CLI output, limits and FAQ.
